sanskrit_verse:
चैत्यश्मशानसीमासु पुण्यस्थाने सुरालये ।
जातद्रुमाणां द्विगुणो दमो वृक्षे च विश्रुते ॥२.२२८॥
transliteration: caityaśmaśānasīmāsu puṇyasthāne surālaye | jātadrumāṇāṃ dviguṇo damo vṛkṣe ca viśrute ||2.228||
sph_interpretive_translation: In sacred spaces, crematorium boundaries, holy places, divine abodes, and under celebrated trees where spontaneous flora arises, the prescribed restitution is double for any harm caused.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority of sacred geography as a determinant of dharmic consequence
Causation rooted in spatial sanctity and consciousness resonance
Capacity-based responsibility increases with proximity to elevated consciousness fields
Restoration logic aligns damage recompense proportionally to spiritual density
Consciousness alignment demands higher energetic integrity in spiritually potent zones
executable_legal_axioms: IF location = [caitya OR smaśāna OR sīmā OR puṇya-sthāna OR surālaya] THEN restitution_multiplier = 2
IF flora_is_spontaneous = TRUE AND location_is_sacred = TRUE THEN restitution_value *= 2
IF action_causes_harm = TRUE AND location_has_elevated_consciousness = TRUE THEN compensation_rate = base_damages × 2
IF tree_is_venerated = TRUE THEN disturbance_cost = 2 × ordinary_damage_cost
supreme_court_application: This verse establishes that the Supreme Court must recognize spatial sanctity as a legal variable determining liability magnitude. Harm within sacred geographies invokes a doubled duty of restoration due to their role as consciousness-conducting matrices essential to societal dharma.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa recognizes that sacred sites conduct higher frequencies; damage disrupts collective consciousness flow. Anupūrvaśaḥ reflects how localized acts disturb extended energetic sequences. Responsibility is proportional to capacity to sense and honor sacredness. Non-punitive reality holds because correction restores energetic balance rather than inflicting pain.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Reintegration through ritualized acknowledgment of violated space
Community-led consciousness recalibration at affected location
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: Dharma is restored when spatial sanctity is honored through proportional restitution. There is no punishment—only realignment of consciousness with its inherent integrity. Reality responds to truth, not force.
